Description

M600-03400100A Control Techniques Unidrive M600 AC Drive 3 Phase, 380–480V, 4.0/5.5 kW (5–7.5 HP)
Overview

The M600-03400100A is a Control Techniques AC drive within the Unidrive M600 series, designed for high-performance motor control of both induction and permanent magnet motors. This model supports 3-phase input operation and delivers flexible output performance up to 5.5 kW depending on application conditions. The M600 series enhances the M300 platform with advanced vector control, integrated communication capabilities, and modular expansion options, making it suitable for precision industrial automation and demanding drive applications.

Key Specifications
SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Input Voltage	380–480 V AC, 3-phase
Input Frequency	48–65 Hz
Motor Power Rating	4.0 kW (5 HP) typical, up to 5.5 kW (7.5 HP)
Output Voltage	0–480 V AC
Output Frequency	0–550 Hz
Control Method	Open-loop & closed-loop vector control (RFC-A)
Protection Rating	IP20
Applications
High-performance motor control in conveyors, pumps, and industrial machinery
Manufacturing systems requiring precise speed and torque control
Retrofit or upgrade of legacy drive systems with advanced vector control

Description

CJ1W-FLN22 Omron CJ Series FL-net Communication Unit
Overview

The CJ1W-FLN22 is an Omron FL-net communication unit designed for the CJ Series programmable controller platform. This CPU Bus Unit enables CJ-series PLCs to connect to FL-net, an Ethernet-based open industrial network used for high-speed controller and machine-level communications. Supporting both cyclic data transmission and message communications, the unit facilitates integration between PLCs, CNC machines, robots, and other automation controllers across multivendor systems. The CJ1W-FLN22 mounts directly to the CPU or expansion rack, providing reliable network connectivity for distributed control and factory automation applications.

Key Specifications
SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Manufacturer	Omron
Series	CJ Series
Product Type	FL-net Communication Unit (CPU Bus Unit)
Network Interface	100BASE-TX (10BASE-T supported)
Transmission Speed	100 Mbps or 10 Mbps
Transmission Media	UTP or STP Ethernet cable (Category 3, 4, 5, or 5e)
Maximum Transmission Distance	100 m (328 ft) between hub and node
Mounting Location	CPU Rack or Expansion Rack
Current Consumption	370 mA max at 5 VDC
Operating Temperature	0 - 55°C (32 - 131°F)
Dimensions (W × H × D)	31 × 90 × 65 mm (1.22 × 3.54 × 2.56 in)
Weight	100 g (0.22 lb) max
Applications
Industrial network integration between PLCs, robots, and CNC systems using FL-net
Factory automation systems requiring controller-level Ethernet communication
Machine integration, plant modernization, and multi-vendor PLC networking

Overview

The 3G3JX-A2004 is an Omron variable frequency drive (VFD) within the JX Series, designed for **compact**, **reliable**, and **efficient motor speed control** in industrial automation systems. This inverter supports a three-phase 200–240 V AC input and delivers precise control for applications requiring optimized energy usage. Rated for 0.4 kW (1/2 HP) motors, the drive features PID control, adjustable acceleration/deceleration, and multi-step speed programming. Its compact panel-mount design integrates easily into control cabinets used in machine automation, conveyor systems, and pump/fan applications.

The D4GS-N4R is an OMRON slim safety door interlock switch from the D4GS-N series, engineered for compact machine safeguarding applications. This safety door switch features 3 normally-closed (NC) slow-action contacts, horizontal key insertion, and a rugged IP67-rated housing for protection against dust and water. Its slim body design makes it ideal for installations where space is limited, while ensuring reliable interlocking of access doors and safety guards in industrial automation systems.

Overview

The ACS550-01-125A-4 is a high-capacity ABB ACS550 AC drive engineered for dependable and energy-efficient control of three-phase motors in demanding industrial environments. As part of the proven ACS550 series, this powerful 100 HP variable frequency drive (VFD) operates on 380 - 480 V AC three-phase power and delivers up to 55 kW (100 HP) in normal duty applications. Featuring IP21 / NEMA Type 1 protection and a robust R5 frame size, this wall-mounted drive is ideal for installation in control panels and electrical rooms. It supports both normal and heavy-duty operating profiles, providing consistent torque performance and precise speed regulation for high-load applications such as pumps, compressors, fans, and heavy material handling systems.

Energy optimization and modernization of three-phase motor installations

Description

NF50-SWU3-003 Mitsubishi NF Series Shunt Trip Unit 3V DC
Overview

The NF50-SWU3-003 is a Mitsubishi shunt trip unit designed for integration with NF Series molded case circuit breakers, specifically compatible with NF50 frame breakers. This breaker accessory enables remote tripping of the breaker through an external control signal, improving system safety and operational control. Operating at 3 V DC, it is suited for low-voltage control circuits and emergency shutdown systems. It installs directly within the breaker housing, supporting both existing NF installations and system upgrades with compatible NF series components.

FX0N-24MR-ES/UL Mitsubishi FX0N Series Programmable Logic Controller Base Unit
Overview

The FX0N-24MR-ES/UL is a Mitsubishi Electric programmable logic controller (PLC) base unit from the FX0N Series, providing 24 total I/O points with integrated relay outputs for flexible industrial control. This compact controller offers 14 digital inputs (24V DC) and 10 relay outputs, allowing for control of both AC and DC loads in automation systems. Designed for reliable performance, it integrates seamlessly into Mitsubishi automation environments for new installations, equipment retrofits, or system upgrades.

Total I/O Points	24 I/O (14 Digital Inputs, 10 Relay Outputs)
Input Type	24 V DC Digital Inputs
Output Type	Relay Outputs (Normally Open Contacts)
Power Supply	100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz
Output Rating	Up to 240 V AC or 30 V DC per output
Dimensions	130 × 90 × 87 mm (5.12 × 3.54 × 3.43 in)
Weight	0.55 kg (1.21 lb)

Description

FX1S-10MR-ES/UL Mitsubishi FX1S Series Programmable Logic Controller Base Unit
Overview

The FX1S-10MR-ES/UL is a Mitsubishi Electric programmable logic controller (PLC) base unit from the FX1S Series, offering compact automation control with integrated digital I/O and relay outputs. This controller provides 10 total I/O points, consisting of 6 digital inputs (24 V DC) and 4 relay outputs, enabling reliable control of both AC and DC loads. Designed for dependable industrial performance, it integrates seamlessly into Mitsubishi automation environments for new installations or system upgrades. The FX1S platform is widely used for compact machine control and serves as an entry-level MELSEC PLC solution.

Total I/O Points	10 I/O (6 Digital Inputs, 4 Relay Outputs)
Input Type	24 V DC Digital Inputs
Output Type	Relay Outputs (Normally Open Contacts)
Power Supply	100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz
Output Rating	Up to 240 V AC or 30 V DC per output
Mounting	Panel mount
Dimensions	60 × 90 × 87 mm (2.36 × 3.54 × 3.43 in)

Overview

The FX2N-48ET is a Mitsubishi Electric programmable logic controller (PLC)  expansion unit from the FX2N Series, offering high-performance digital control with transistor outputs for fast-switching automation. Featuring 48 total I/O points—including 24 digital inputs (24 V DC) and 24 transistor outputs—it is ideal for high-speed applications. Designed for industrial-grade reliability, the unit integrates seamlessly into Mitsubishi automation systems, supporting advanced functionality and expansion within the MELSEC FX platform.

Overview

The AAM51 is a Yokogawa analog output module — a Current/Voltage Output Module — designed for use in Yokogawa distributed control systems such as CENTUM CS / CENTUM VP (or equivalent legacy platforms). It delivers configurable analog outputs (either current — typically 4–20 mA — or voltage — 0–10 V DC) for process control, measurement signalling or analog control output tasks. The module is compact and integrates into I/O racks/adaptor nests for process instrumentation and control loops.

CSH01.1C-PL-ENS-MEM-MA1-NN-S-NN-FW Bosch Rexroth IndraDrive Advanced Control Section
Overview

The CSH01.1C-PL-ENS-MEM-MA1-NN-S-NN-FW is a Bosch Rexroth IndraDrive advanced control section designed for high-performance single-axis motion and drive control. Part of the CSH Advanced Controllers series, this unit features a Parallel Interface (PL) master communication architecture, standard multi-format encoder evaluation (ENS), and an integrated MEM memory slot for parameter storage and configuration management. With dual analog outputs and robust industrial design, it integrates seamlessly into Rexroth IndraDrive systems for precise, reliable automation in demanding environments.

Master Communication	Parallel Interface (PL)

Memory Expansion	Integrated MEM slot for parameter storage
Control Section Variant	CSH Advanced Controller, single-axis

Machine tools, handling systems, and industrial production lines

Designed for demanding industrial automation environments, this controller delivers deterministic communication, robust feedback handling, and flexible I/O integration for precision automation applications.

Key Specifications
SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Master Communication	Parallel Interface
Primary Encoder Support	HSF / RSF encoder options
Analog Outputs	2 channels
Digital I/O	16 inputs & 16 outputs (grouped)
Memory Module	PFM02.1 multimedia card & MEM module
Power Consumption	7.5 W at 24 V DC
Applications
Single-axis motion control in servo drive systems
Automated machinery requiring deterministic communication and encoder feedback
Industrial automation applications including packaging, robotics, and material handling

The CSB01.1C-SE-ENS-EN1-L1-S-NN-FW is a Bosch Rexroth IndraDrive CSB01 series compact converter and servo drive controller designed for high-performance motion control in industrial automation environments. Featuring SERCOS master communication and flexible encoder feedback support, this control section is ideal for integrated drive-control applications requiring precision, reliability, and scalable system design.

Key Specifications
SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Model / Series	CSB01.1C-SE-ENS-EN1-L1-S-NN-FW / CSB01
Master Communication Interface	SERCOS Interface
Encoder Option 1	IndraDyn / Hiperface / 1 Vpp / TTL
Encoder Option 2	HSF / RSF
Safety Option	Starting Lockout (L1)
Configuration Option	Configurable control module
Applications
Precision motion control applications in industrial automation systems
Integrated servo drive control in manufacturing and processing equipment
Replacement or expansion within Rexroth IndraDrive CSB01 installations

Description

20AE017A0AYNNNC0 Allen-Bradley PowerFlex 70 AC Drive
Overview

The 20AE017A0AYNNNC0 is an Allen-Bradley PowerFlex 70 AC drive engineered for advanced industrial motor control applications. Designed for 600 V three-phase input, this adjustable frequency drive delivers 17 A output and supports motors up to 15 HP (11 kW). Featuring enhanced control capabilities with V/Hz and sensorless vector control, this unit provides reliable variable speed and torque regulation for demanding automation environments. The panel-mount configuration includes an IP20 / NEMA Type 1 enclosure, blank HIM cover, and integrated brake IGBT, making it ideal for machinery panels and system integration projects.

Brake	Built-in Brake IGBT

Variable speed motor control for industrial machinery such as conveyors, pumps, and fans.

Description

ABB ACH550-BC-059A-4+E213+F267 AC Drive with E-Bypass and Circuit Breaker

The ABB ACH550-BC-059A-4+E213+F267 is a high-performance AC Adjustable Frequency Drive from the trusted ABB ACH550 family, engineered specifically for HVAC systems and general-purpose motor control. This configuration features an integrated E-Bypass with Circuit Breaker for simplified maintenance and operational continuity, making it ideal for commercial and industrial facilities requiring dependable motor control.

Designed for 380 - 480 VAC, 3-phase power systems, this 59 A rated drive supports approximately 40 HP motors (typical at 480 V) and includes factory-installed options such as a line reactor (+E213) and service switch (+F267). With embedded HVAC functionality, advanced diagnostics, and built-in communication capabilities, the ACH550 ensures optimized energy efficiency, reduced downtime, and seamless building automation integration.

Description

ABB TB82PH1010211 PH / ORP / PION TRANSMITTER
Two-wire, loop-powered analyzer with rugged NEMA 4X / IP65 housing
2-Year Warranty Available
Emergency Shipping
20+ Years Experience
FM Approved
Product Overview

The ABB TB82PH1010211 is a two-wire, loop-powered transmitter for pH, ORP (Redox), and pIon measurements. It features a bright LCD with a user-friendly keypad for straightforward configuration and calibration, plus an integrated lightning suppressor to protect against surge events. The TB82PH series is engineered for demanding industrial environments and carries a NEMA 4X / IP65 anodized, powder-coated aluminum enclosure for dependable field performance.

Key Features & Benefits
Two-Wire, Loop-Powered
Simplifies installation and reduces wiring costs while delivering a stable 4–20 mA signal.
Flexible Measurements
Supports pH (0–14), ORP/pIon (±1999 mV) with selectable temperature compensation modes.
Integrated Surge Protection
Built-in lightning suppressor tested to 20 kA pulses for extra resilience.
Hazardous Area Ready
FM non-incendive / intrinsically safe approvals and robust environmental ratings.
Easy to Use
Clear menus, secondary display options, and security codes streamline setup and operation.
Rugged Construction
Powder-coated aluminum housing with NEMA 4X / IP65 protection for harsh conditions.
Complete Technical Specifications
SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Manufacturer	ABB Measurement & Analytics
Part Number	TB82PH1010211
Series / Type	TB82PH Advantage Series – 2-wire pH / ORP / pIon transmitter
Programming Option	1 = Basic
Digital Communications	0 = None (analog 4–20 mA only)
Lightning Suppressor	1 = Included (tested 20 kA, 8×20 μs pulses)
Housing Type	0 = Powder-coated anodized aluminum

Tag	1 = Stainless steel

Display / Resolution	Large LCD; pH display accuracy ±0.01 pH; ORP/pIon ±1 mV; output ±0.02 mA
Outputs	Isolated 4–20 mA, configurable linear/non-linear; minimum span pH 1.00, ORP/pIon 100 mV
Power Requirements	14–53 VDC (14–42 VDC for certified applications); HART models require 250 Ω (not applicable to this code)
Environmental Ratings	NEMA 4X / IP65 enclosure
Operating Temperature	–20 to +60 °C (–4 to +140 °F); up to 95% RH
Dimensions	1/2 DIN; 144 × 144 × 171 mm (5.67 × 5.67 × 6.73 in)
Weight	Approx. 1.9 kg (4.2 lb) base unit
Typical Applications
Water & Wastewater

Continuous pH and ORP monitoring for treatment optimization and compliance.

Chemical Processing

Corrosion control, neutralization, and quality assurance in harsh environments.

Power & Pulp/Paper

Condensate/feedwater control and process monitoring across plant utilities.

Notable Capabilities
Selectable temperature compensation including manual, standard Nernstian, and solution-coefficient modes.
Security controls with programmable access codes to protect configuration and calibration.
Adjustable damping (0.0–99.9 s) for noisy processes and stable outputs.
Secondary display can show temperature, loop current, mV, or software revision.

Description

1B30023H01 Emerson Ovation I/O Bus Terminator
Overview

The 1B30023H01 is an Emerson I/O bus terminator module for use in the Ovation™ distributed control system (DCS). It provides proper bus termination to maintain signal integrity for I/O communications, preventing reflections and ensuring stable data transmission across the control network. Designed for reliable operation in industrial automation and control environments, it enables seamless integration with other Ovation system modules.

Explore our complete range of automation products — from PLC modules to HMIs, power supplies, drives, and more. We supply parts from leading global manufacturers including Siemens, Allen-Bradley, ABB, Omron, B&R, Mitsubishi, GE – General Electric, Phoenix Contact, Modicon, Lenze, Schneider, Automation Direct, SICK, Honeywell, Banner (Banner Engineering), FANUC, Parker, Beckhoff, Moore, SEW EURODRIVE, Yaskawa, Yokogawa, and more.

Browse All Parts →

SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Function	I/O Bus Terminator Module for Ovation DCS
Power Supply	24 V DC
Communication Interface	RS-485 / Ovation I/O bus
Purpose	Termination of I/O bus to prevent signal reflections and maintain bus integrity
Environmental / Operating Conditions	Indoor use, nominal industrial environment (per Ovation system specs)
System Compatibility	OEM module for Emerson Ovation / Westinghouse Ovation DCS families
Applications
Termination of I/O bus networks in Ovation distributed control systems.
Power generation plants, water/wastewater treatment facilities, or other process-control installations using Ovation architecture.
Maintaining signal integrity in complex automation installations — new builds, retrofits, or legacy system maintenance.

Description

1734-EPAC/A Allen-Bradley POINT I/O AC Expansion Power Supply, AC Input, 85 - 264 Volt AC, 1.3 Amp, DIN Rail Mount
Overview

The 1734-EPAC/A is an Allen-Bradley POINT I/O AC expansion power supply designed to extend field power and provide backplane bus current within the 1734 POINT I/O system. This module enables efficient power distribution and segmentation in distributed I/O architectures, supporting flexible system growth and simplified maintenance. Built for demanding industrial environments, it ensures stable performance, modular scalability, and reliable operation across factory automation and process control applications.

Key Specifications
SPECIFICATION	VALUE
Field Power Input	120 / 240 V AC, 50 / 60 Hz (85 - 264 V AC)
POINTBus Output Current	1.3 A @ 5.2 V DC (horizontal), 1.0 A @ 5.2 V DC (vertical)
I/O Module Support	Up to 17 modules (depending on current draw)
Inrush Current	2 A for 6 ms
Overvoltage Protection	MOV and fuse protection
Operating Temperature	-20 °C - 55 °C (-4 °F - 131 °F)
Mounting	DIN-rail mounting, open style
Applications
Powering and extending field supply in POINT I/O distributed control systems.
Factory automation and process control environments requiring expansion of I/O modules.
Partitioning field power between module groups for logical and functional segmentation.
Machine building applications where modular scalability and flexible I/O layout are essential.

RD77MS16 Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC iQ-R Simple Motion Module
Overview

The RD77MS16 is a Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC iQ-R Series Simple Motion Module designed for advanced motion control within industrial automation systems. It supports up to 16 control axes via SSCNET III/H communication, enabling complex positioning and motion profiles when integrated with a PLC CPU and servo amplifiers.

Product Type	Simple Motion Module
Series / Family	MELSEC iQ-R Series
Number of Control Axes	16 Axes
Command Interface	SSCNET III/H
Program Capacity	600 Positioning Data / Axis
Inputs	20
Dimensions (W×H×D)	27.8 × 106 × 110 mm (1.1 × 4.17 × 4.33 in)
Weight	0.23 kg (0.51 lbs)
Applications
Motion control and positioning for multi-axis servo systems in manufacturing equipment
Integration with MELSEC iQ-R PLCs for coordinated machine automation
Upgrade of legacy systems to advanced interpolation and synchronous control
